description:
Hi all,

I was getting a little tired of seeing the same names show up during character creation and on NPCs — and was surprised there weren’t more (or any?) mods addressing this. Ship names? Sure. Character names? Not so much. So this is my small attempt to add some variety and flavour to the game with lore-friendly names used during character creation and across NPCs.

I originally made this for myself, but figured others might get use out of it too. So, I present:

ez's Additional Character Names

Download v1.1.1
ZIP 15 KB - unpacked 74 KB
GitHub -> https://github.com/frolic9359/ez_additional_names

What is it?
A lightweight add-on that drops in roughly 2,600 lore-friendly names the game can use for both your captain and every NPC.

Key Features

About 1,500 first names, 800 last names, 150 dual-use
Every faction covered and thematically weighted to their vanilla "feel"
Version Checker & mod-manager compatible (auto-updates via GitHub)

Random sample names

Pirates - Nozar Nytek, Larrence Soflekruk, Bernadine Amaral, Scarred Scarn Clent, Nalra Ysvair
Tri-Tachyon - Dawson Aelber, Xvek Skordren, Miriam al-Mansoor, Falan Leenalra, Chiara Russum
Hegemony - Skormur Zailoah, Olivia Darmammert, Scuti Rhyne, Venven Azuma, Ulvaor Sugiyama
Independents - Red Gong, Ilaria Zhan, Errol Bukasa, Ember M'baye, Diego Pratr
Luddic Church - Ezra Grimaldthel, Joella Mariqua, Caleb Tharzir, Ismachiah Holbach, Amen Thareziah
Luddic Path - Nomi Narva, Pascal Zhtrak, Dalton Qxxel, Zaiiah Darneely, Grimtharthel Dituri
Persean League - Osip Varos, Zinaida Ricedthar, Grimwyn Zvek, Xilxvek Ielzaithar, Krilzx Ionrosys
Sindrian Diktat - Arthir Budionir, Patricia Xqven, Kimra Behr, Diphda Drenskormur, Delphini Qiu

How it works
Each name has one or two category tags (modern, world, luddic, myth, future, fringe, old english).
Starsector's generator weights those tags differently for every faction. A Luddic Path officer is *more likely* to roll a pious-sounding name, and pirates have better odds to be scary, outlaw-sounding - but nothing is exclusive. You will still meet a pirate with a plain surname, or a Tri-Tach exec with a normal given name.

Compatibility
This mod is purely additive so it should have no issues alongside other mods.

Installation

Unzip to *Starsector/mods/*
Enable in the launcher

Roadmap

Add more names for under-used pools (myth, old english)
Even-out gender balance
Keep pace with future Starsector releases

Changelog

Spoiler
## Changelog - ez's Additional Character Names

### v1.1.1 (2025-05-13)
- Category tidy-up and stricter tagging

### v1.1.0 (2024-05-04)
- Updated for Starsector 0.98a
- +900 new names (total > 2,600)
- Now hosted on GitHub and compatible with mod managers

### v1.0.1 (2023-05-19)
- Updated for Starsector version 0.96a

### v1.0.0 (2022-06-30)
- Initial release

If anyone wants to use any part of this mod, or steal it completely, please feel free :)
